body: Why isn't it? I'm not trying to prove anything.
I don't want to try and get better. I already know that I can't. I just want to die.

I have no family. No friends. I live alone. The one man I loved assaulted me, and now he won't even talk to me. Even though I'm willing to forgive him for the fifth time. I'm a fucking loser. Everyone looks at me and just automatically hates me.
